abilities.name: Mire Pitchfork
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Grit against enemies in salvage, hazard, or mire sectors.

abilities.name: Compost Cape
abilities.text: Once per round, the first yellow trap or ambush you face has -1 difficulty.

abilities.name: Yard King
abilities.text: Once per round, after you clear a salvage, hazard, or mire sector, gain 1 Salvage.

abilities.name: Ripe Warning
abilities.text: When another operative enters your sector, they may inspect one unresolved yellow blocker there. Weakness: when you fail a blue Anomaly test, take 1 Wound unless you discard 1 Salvage.
